title: Convergent · Overview
description: The path, attention, host and guests on one screen.

panels.title: The network path
panels.description: Source: node up, Incus CPU series, fw-facts CARP/pf and wan-check upstream lease. This is a logical path, not host forwarding: each downstream segment uses a CARP gateway. Both roles agree when all six interfaces have the same role; Network shows each segment. UP on wan means an accepted lease, not a Wi-Fi association or an Internet probe.

panels.title: Instances · now
panels.description: Source: Incus /1.0/metrics; tools/check cv_guest_expected_running supplies autostart guests missing now. A stopped guest is shown only while the Incus scrape answers. RAM is total minus available; agentless fw/wan VMs report capped QEMU RSS against configured RAM. Their CPU counts QEMU vCPU thread overhead, excluding guest execution. These are not guest utilization. Rates use two minutes.

targets.expr: (count by (project,name) (incus_cpu_seconds_total{job="incus"}) > bool 0 or max by (project,name) (cv_guest_expected_running) * 0) and on() (max(up{job="incus"}) == 1)
